summary: Explains basic when conditionals: a raw Jinja2 expression without curly braces evaluated per host, with an example enabling an SELinux boolean only where SELinux is enabled.
questions: How do I write a when condition in Ansible?
Do I need curly braces in a when clause?
How do I run a task only when SELinux is enabled?

answer_card.title: Basic when conditionals
answer_card.answer_md:
Add `when:` with a raw Jinja2 expression (no `{{ }}`). The task runs on hosts where it's true:

```yaml
- ansible.posix.seboolean:
    name: mysql_connect_any
    state: true
    persistent: true
  when: ansible_selinux.status == "enabled"
```
